question: When palletized bagged cement arrives with hardened outer bags but intact inner bags, how should a research agent distinguish rain exposure, stretch-wrap condensation, warehouse floor moisture and pre-existing packing-line moisture before allocating responsibility?
category: Bagged cement pallet moisture exposure and custody
scenario: Localized cement bag hardening across a pallet shipment with disputed origin of moisture
evidence_required: Bag lot and pallet traceability, packing timestamps, bag material specification, pallet photos at dispatch and receipt
Transport rain and humidity records, trailer roof/side integrity, stretch-wrap coverage, condensation observations and seal records
Warehouse floor and wall moisture survey, pallet spacing, storage duration, bag-by-bag damage map and retained production samples
answer_and_decision_guide: Map damage by pallet face, height and bag layer; align dispatch and receipt condition records with weather, storage and transport timeline. Distinguish liquid ingress patterns from vapor condensation and pre-existing bag moisture using qualified sampling and material tests. Preserve chain of custody and request independent inspection before making a claim. Avoid inferring a universal safe humidity threshold or liability from photographs alone.
source_provenance: Seller-maintained navigation only; obtain packaging manufacturer specifications, applicable cement storage standards and actual carrier/warehouse evidence independently.
free_first_decision: Use original packaging records, retained samples, damage mapping and applicable freely accessible storage guidance before considering paid material.

conditional_paid_check.authorization: Only consider a paid reference after verifying the specific inventory filename, edition, usage rights and current price, and obtaining explicit buyer authorization; never initiate payment.

model_limitations: No shipment inspection, bag samples, weather logs or applicable contract terms supplied; cannot determine moisture origin, product fitness or liability.
